Renata of Lorraine( 20 April 1544 – 22 May 1602) was by birth a member of the House of Lorraine and by marriage Duchess of Bavaria.
Born in Nancy, France, she was the second child and eldest daughter of Francis I, Duke of Lorraine and Christina of Denmark.
Her paternal grandparents were Antoine, Duke of Lorraine and Renée of Bourbon- Montpensier and her maternal grandparents were Christian II of Denmark and Isabella of Austria.
